reviews.title: I Would Highly Suggest This Item...PERFECT!
reviews.comment: The RØDE PSA1+ Professional Studio Arm has been an outstanding addition to my daily broadcast and voice-over workflow for weather forecasting and studio production. As someone who records voice tracks and delivers forecasts regularly, having stable, quiet, and highly adjustable microphone positioning is extremely important — and this studio arm performs exceptionally well in every category. The build quality is excellent and immediately feels professional-grade. The arm is incredibly stable, moves smoothly, and holds microphone positioning precisely without drifting or sagging over time. The spring damping system works beautifully and provides nearly silent operation during adjustments, which is critical in voice-over and recording environments where unwanted mechanical noise can easily be picked up by sensitive microphones. One of the strongest features is the cable management system. It keeps the setup clean, organized, and professional-looking while reducing cable interference during recording sessions. In a busy studio or weather production environment, maintaining a clutter-free workspace is a major advantage. The arm’s range of motion and adjustability are also excellent. It allows quick positioning changes for live broadcasts, voice-over recording, weather updates, and long studio sessions while maintaining very smooth movement and strong support for professional microphones. Another major advantage is the reduction in desk vibration and handling noise. The PSA1+ does an excellent job isolating the microphone and helping maintain clean, broadcast-quality audio during recording. This has made a noticeable difference in overall production quality for weather narration and studio reporting work. The overall design is sleek, durable, and clearly built for long-term professional use. Even with daily operation, the arm continues to perform flawlessly and feels engineered specifically for serious studio environments. Highly recommend the RØDE PSA1+ to broadcasters, meteorologists, podcasters, voice-over professionals, streamers, and studio production teams looking for professional microphone support with outstanding stability, quiet operation, and premium build quality. Exceptional performance and absolutely worth the investment for professional audio production.
reviews.author: X Rock Radio

reviews.title: RODE quality is worth the extra cost.
reviews.comment: First bought the popular (and much cheaper) Chinese arm available on Amazon. That one was hard to adjust, hard to move out of the way (both to retract the arm and to swivel), and the microphone would not stay "tight". The RODE arm is SO MUCH BETTER. The RODE desk mount is sturdier and allows the arm to swivel easily without feeling "loose" and wobbly. The arm is very well balanced, so it extends and retracts with very little effort. The microphone locking system is perfect; easy to connect securely, but easy to remove if needed. Finally, the cable-management clips make it easy to keep the setup looking clean. Bonus, the RODE also comes with a bolt-thru desk mount if you do not like the clamp style. TLDR: Pay the extra money if you can afford it, you will be much happier with this product over cheaper options.
reviews.author: Alyssa Barnes

reviews.title: Solid, Smooth, and Professional – Worth the Upgrade
reviews.comment: I bought the RØDE PSA1+ to use with my home recording setup, and it immediately elevated my workspace. The build quality feels very solid and premium, and the arm moves smoothly without any sudden drops or squeaks. The spring damping really makes a difference, adjustments are quiet and controlled, which is important when recording. I also appreciate the built-in cable management. It keeps everything looking clean and organized, especially on a desk where there are already a lot of cables. Once mounted, it holds the microphone securely in place and stays exactly where I position it, even during longer sessions. This feels like a professional-grade studio arm that’s clearly designed with creators in mind. If you want a stable, quiet, and polished setup for recording, streaming, or voice work, this is a great investment and doesn’t feel flimsy or cheap at all.
reviews.author: Kitkat's Kitchen

reviews.title: Works & looks great shelf mounted on the wall to free up desk surface!
reviews.comment: I read many reviews looking for comments about mounting this product on a shelf located above & in front of my workspace, but couldn't find any, so I'm providing this review as a courtesy to others looking for the same. I'm pleased to discover that this mic arm works perfectly because it stays put when you retract or extend the mic arm. I was concerned about the weight, but no issues there. The reach length is also great and easily goes downward below the shelf. When I'm not using it, I just push it upward out of the way. I like that it doesn't occupy any desk surface, and I'm not bumping into it with my elbow. Plus the mounting clamp is thick sturdy metal, not plastic. Just be sure if you do a setup like this, that your shelf is secured well to the wall studs and the shelf itself is sturdy. My mic arm is mounted approx. 3ft from where I sit and the shelf is about 2.5ft above my desk. I adjusted the distance of the mount from my desk chair to get it perfect, which is easy to do because the clamp mounting bracket is easy to move. When pushed up, the arm folds & the mic is at the same level as the shelf, and pulled down, the mic is directly in front of my mouth for speaking. I used closet shelving with basic "L" brackets from the big box hardware store for my library because it was cheaper & easier than buying furniture/bookshelves. If I need to, I can switch out the Podmic for a boom mic & it will still work nicely. Overall, the mic setup looks & works great mounted with my library, so I'm glad I spent the extra bucks for a quality product. Plus it matches my Rode Podmic! Thanks Rode. ;0)
